name: 2-Board Bench Press
description: The 2-Board Bench Press uses two stacked 2-inch boards on the chest, reducing range of motion by approximately 4 inches. This version shifts the mechanical emphasis further toward the triceps and mid-to-upper pressing range, making it a highly effective overload and sticking-point training tool for powerlifters and advanced bench pressers.

execution.starting_position: Lie on a flat bench. A partner holds two stacked 2-inch boards on the chest. Take a shoulder-width or slightly wider grip on the bar.
execution.setup_instructions: Stack two 2x6 or 2x8 boards. Have a training partner hold them or secure with elastic bands around the torso. Approx 4 inches of reduced ROM.
steps: Step 1: Unrack the bar and control the descent to the board stack.
Step 2: Touch the boards and pause for one second.
Step 3: Press powerfully back to full lockout.
Step 4: Lower under control and repeat.
execution.breathing_instructions: Inhale and brace before the descent. Exhale as the bar passes the sticking point on the way up.
common_mistakes: Relaxing the upper back during the touch at the board
Letting the boards shift position during the set
safety_considerations: Loads used should be greater than full ROM max — ensure spotter awareness
Partner must hold boards securely throughout the set
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Bar to board surface only. Full elbow lockout at top.
coaching_cues: Treat the board like the floor — press explosively off it
Keep tension in the lats throughout
